name: Mushak Dash
description: A Vinayaka Chaturthi Festival Adventure featuring the 2D pilgrimage runner and 14 authentic festival games: Modak Tower Stacker, Laddoo Rush, Visarjan Miraj, 108 Divine Names, Diya Mandala, Durva Puja, Pandal Decorator, Jigsaw Puzzle, Rangoli, Modak Kitchen, Dhol Tasha, Shringaar Aarti, Eco-Clay, and Bhakti Memory.
